content:
Samir: Heads up — noticed streaming requests started to pile up around 14:02 UTC. GPU pool at 95% in us-west1, non-stream (batch) queue length spiked too. Streaming QPS ~120, batch QPS ~35. Tail token latency for streaming >800ms. We saw ~1.2k queued streaming tokens.
Devon: ugh. Any recent deploys? @Anika?
Anika: no deploys. Saw a config tweak yesterday to batch_size=128 on the large pool; might be affecting prefetch and KV cache churn.
Priya: adding context — request distribution changed: longer contexts (3k+) from partner app, causing KV growth and OOM retries on some pods.
Samir: autoscaler-bot reported scale event at 14:05 but scale-up plateaued due to instance quota in us-west1.
autoscaler-bot: [alert] attempted scale +8 gpus; quota limit hit. https://console.cloud/quotas/12345
Devon: quota… that's new. Cost team bumped reserved capacity? @Priya any idea which quota?
Priya: it's the GPU VMs (n1-standard-16 + a100) soft quota. Eng infra is on it.
Anika: operational question — do we prefer prioritizing streaming (low latency) over batch (throughput) when under capacity? We can do token-weighted admission: streaming=1.0, batch=0.3.
Samir: Current admission allows 100 evictions/minute; rate limiter is per model not per request type. Need per-path weights.
Devon: Proposed quick mitigation: throttle new long-context streaming sessions at edge and route a subset to a lower-cost quantized variant. Example config:
```
admission:
  global_qps: 200
  weights:
    streaming: 0.8
    non_stream: 0.4
  queue_size: 5000
  backpressure_policy: shed_oldest
```
Anika: +1 also set streaming_preempt=true for critical-tier customers. That reduces batch tokens admitted when GPU_util>85%.
Priya: we should also open a temporary routing rule to us-east1 where quota is OK; need playbook for cross-region latency impact.
Devon: can we degrade streaming to chunked non-stream (pseudo-stream) for long contexts? That reduces KV size by keeping shorter active context.
Samir: good idea — convert >2048 context to chunked-mode so we avoid storing full KV for streaming. Might increase client-side complexity.
Priya: Cost callout — chunking and quantized model reduces per-token cost ~30%, but client dev time is non-zero.
Anika: I'll push a canary of admission weights to 10% traffic for 10m. Samir, can you coordinate quota escalation with infra?
Samir: on it. Created ticket INFRA-4721 and pinged cloud-quotas. Also putting a short note in #incidents.
Devon: After canary, let's collect these metrics: queued_tokens, head_latency, preempted_batch_count, cross_region_extra_ms.
Samir: ack. Adding a small dashboard. If scale-up fails we'll enable shed_oldest and streaming_preempt globally.
Anika: thanks. Keeping this thread for coordination.
Priya: FYI linking runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/ingress-backpressure
Devon: :thumbsup:
